latestPosts.caption:
The colours are shifting and the landscape around Arctic Bath is changing with the season.

Time spent in nature, the warmth of the spa and flavours inspired by the season give autumn its own character at Arctic Bath.

A beautiful time to experience the north.

#ArcticBath #Harads #NorthernSweden #Autumn

Warmth against cold. Movement followed by stillness. A deep breath before stepping into Arctic water.

Fire & Ice is a four-day retreat at Arctic Bath, created around the contrasts of the Arctic, bringing together yoga, breathwork, sauna rituals and cold immersion to awaken the senses and return to the present moment.

Over four days, experience guided breathwork and meditation, restorative yoga and Arctic sauna rituals, balanced with time for rest, nature and seasonal dining.

All held in the stillness of Swedish Lapland, with @petranil, founder of @masteryogasweden, guiding the journey.

19–22 November 2026.

#ArcticBath #FireAndIceRetreat #MasterYogaSweden #SwedishLapland #WellnessRetreat

Å tjänstens vägnar fick @mwj65 möjlighet att återigen besöka fantastiska och unika @arcticbath_sweden. Det här är verkligen en anläggning utöver det vanliga. 🤩 

Delägaren @speteng berättar om historien bakom skapelsen, och att arkitekturen är en hyllning till regionens timmerarv och Luleälvens historia. 🪵 

Vi tar det från början. I Harads, mitt i den vackra norrbottniska naturen, ligger @arcticbath_sweden. Det är en plats där design, historia och natur bokstavligen flyter ihop på Luleälven. 

Den cirkulära byggnaden med restaurang, bastu och kallbad är ritad av arkitekten Bertil Harström. Byggnaden är inspirerad av den gamla timmerflottningen på Luleälven och ser ut som en timmerbröt mitt ute i vattnet. Riktigt häftigt! 👌

Stugorna på vatten är ritad av tornedalingen Johan Kauppi. Stugornas lutande, nästan ”på väg att falla” form har kopplats till de äldre flottarstugorna längs älven, vars fundament kunde börja ge efter och få husen att luta pga vatten, is, snö och älvens krafter. 

Landstugorna är ritad av AnnKathrin Lundqvist. Deras triangulära form är inspirerad av ett traditionellt verktyg som flottarna använde för att lösa upp timmerbrötar, en så kallad flottningshake. Verktyget hade en spetsig form som användes för att få isär stockarna när de hade fastnat. 

Allt det här är så häftigt och coolt! 😍 På sommaren flyter @arcticbath_sweden på älven. På vintern fryser det fast i isen. Och däremellan väntar kallbad, bastu, stillhet och den magiska känslan av att vara nära naturen. 😇

@discoveringtellus har varit här och vi kan konstatera att besöksnäringen är som bäst när arkitektur, historia och natur får skapa något riktigt unikt. 💙❄️

#arcticbath #swedishlapland #arcticsweden #visitsweden #discoveringtellus

In the stillness of Arctic winter, we invite you to pause.

From 19–22 November, Fire & Ice returns to Arctic Bath for an intimate four-day retreat shaped by the contrasts at the heart of our experience: warmth and cold, movement and stillness, fire and ice.

Led by @petranil, founder of @masteryogasweden, the retreat combines yoga, meditation and breathwork in the warmth of the lavvu with guided cold immersion in the river, Julevädno sauna rituals, seasonal Arctic dining and time for deep rest.

The programme also includes a curated Sápmi experience with Silba Siida, offering a deeper connection to the landscape and culture of the region.

A chance to slow down, awaken the senses and rediscover your inner strength – surrounded by the quiet beauty of Swedish Lapland.

Fire & Ice Retreat
19–22 November 2026

Discover the full programme and reserve your place via the link in bio.

#ArcticBath #FireAndIceRetreat #SwedishLapland #WellnessRetreat #YogaRetreat

A redefined classic.

Floating between two skies. ✨

They drifted. Didn’t speak. Watched the world hold itself in perfect, impossible stillness.

Nobody planned to stop. The river just made them. A silence so complete it had texture. The clouds had come down to meet the river and the river had risen to meet the clouds and somewhere in that slow, wordless exchange, the horizon ceased to exist.

There are places that ask nothing of the clock. That fold time back on itself until past and present dissolve into something softer, something without edges.

This was one of them. ✨

@arcticbath_sweden

Whether it’s working together from the very beginning as your wedding planner, coordinating the logistics as the date gets closer, or providing structure in the planning process, our partnership is built on one clear goal:

To make your wedding here a tailored, seamless, unforgettable experience.

So that when the date arrives, it’s not just an “I do” - it’s an escape that feels like a getaway, right on home ground.

biography:
Floating Saunas on the Fjord in Flåm & Aurland, Norway!
Disconnect, reset, and simply be. 
Welcome to flight mode for the mind.

latestPosts.caption:
One of the last days of late summer before the colder and darker weather came. One of our favourite things about the area here, it that you can go from breathtaking hikes to swims in the fjord, sauna, cinnamon buns and good food within an hour. We started our day with a prest to Hike, continued down to the sauna for some heath and fjord swim, then headed over to @mariannebakeriogkafe for an amazing lunch, coffee and cinnamon buns. 

Ein av dei siste finværsdagane i september før høsten virkelig kom til Vestlandet. Noko av det beste me veit med å vere her, er at ein kan vere på ein fantastisk tur - og innan ein time vere nede igjen til fjorden, ta sauna, eit friskt bad og ete god mat. 

Me starta dagen med ein tur til Prest med fantastisk utsikt. Deretter varma me oss skikkelig opp i sauna før me kjølte oss ned i fjorden. Og selvfølgelig reiste me innom @mariannebakeriogkafe for lunsj og deilig bakst etterpå.

One of our guests favourite features at the Flåm saunas - the bathing hatch. 

What do you prefer: a cold dip through the hatch, or jumping straight into the fjord from the outside?

Badeluka er ein av favorittdelane våre på badstovene i Flåm. 

Kva føretrekk du - ein kald dukkert gjennom badeluka, eller å hoppe rett i fjorden frå utsida?

Sauna i haustferien? 

No som lufta har blitt litt kaldare og dagane litt kortare, føles det passande å senke tempoet litt. Finne roen i varme badstover, ta kalde fjordbad og ha litt ekstra god tid til å berre vere. 

Er de ein større gjeng, fleire vener eller kanskje familie som har samlast i ferien? Då kan de booke sauna både i Flåm og Aurland - anten privat sauna, privat sauna med rituale, eller bli med på fellessauna. De vel sjølve kva som passar dykk best.

De kan booke via Fjordsauna.no. 

Sauna during the autumn holidays? 

Travelling with a big group, friends or family? Then we would suggest booking a sauna session together. Whether you want a private sauna, a private sauna with a sauna ritual, or to join a shared session. You choose what suits your group, booking via Fjordsauna.com. 

As the air gets colder and the days get shorter, it feels extra good to slow down a little. Warm saunas, cold fjord dips and plenty of time to simply be.
Pov: You book at floating sauna session in Norway during winter.

It has been a journey🧖🏽‍♀️🧖🏼Thank you so much to all of you who support, visit, follow and share your experience with us. We’re so grateful! 

Det har vore ei reise! Tusen takk til alle som støttar, besøker, følger og deler dei fine opplevingane med oss. Me er så takksame.

Sauna and cold plunge during Norwegian winter. So so refreshing. <3 

Sauna og eit kaldt bad på vinteren, det er så friskt og godt.

We are so proud of these products!! And we hope you love them too. Available in the sauna shop in Flåm. 🧼🧖🏽‍♀️

Me er så stolte av desse produktene!! Og me håpar de likar dei like godt som me gjer. Tilgjengelige i sauna butikken vår i Flåm.

The perfect autumn day in Aurland. 

It includes three things: A hike in the beautiful mountains with breathtaking views from the top, a freshly baked cinnamon or cardamom bun from @mariannebakeriogkafe (THE best!!) and ending the day with a warm sauna session and a refreshing dip in the cold fjord. The ultimate way to disconnect, reset, and simply be. 

Ein perfekt haustdag i Aurland. 

Hausten er den finaste tida på året for å oppleve naturen her. Me elskar å setje av ein heil dag til fjelltur – og å feire på toppen med ein nybakt kanelbolle frå Marianne’s Bakeri, medan me nyt den spektakulære utsikta over fjorden.

Når me kjem ned att, er det ingenting som føles betre enn varme seg i saunaen før ein kald dukkert i fjorden. Den beste oppskrifta for å kople av, nullstille og berre vere til stades.

The most spectacular locations. <3 

📍 Aurland and Flåm, Western Norway.

The sauna season is in full swing! 

It’s been less than a week since we launched our FjordSauna membership, and we’re so happy to see so many locals embracing it already.

With the air getting crisper and the days a little shorter, there’s no better time to slow down, warm up, and enjoy the sauna. 🍂🍁

Sauna sesongen er i full gang! 

Det er mindre enn ei veka sidan me lanserte FjordSauna medlemskap og me er så glade for å sjå at så mange vil vere ein del av felleskapet. 

Lufta blir litt kaldare og dagane litt kortare no. Då er det ekstra godt å senke tempo litt, nyte varme badstover og kalde fjordbad. Det er jo virkelig noko av det beste med haust og vinter.

A much deeper sauna experience, where you use all your sense. 

Elevate your visit with our 90-minute private sauna experience, complete with a guided Aufguss ritual led by an experienced Sauna Master. Available by request at both locations.

Your ritual includes:

- Three guided Aufguss rounds led by Sauna Master (typically 45-60 min)
- Signature aufguss ritual with essential oils
- Swim in the fjord
- Alcohol-free welcome drink on arrival
- Natural body scrub
- Ca. 30-45 minutes of private sauna time
- Towels provided - one for sitting, one for drying off

Vil du prøve ei 90-minutt lang privat saunaøkt med guida aufgussrituale leia av saunameister? Me har det tilgjengeleg på førespurnad, både i Flåm og Aurland.

Ritualet inneheld:

- 90-minutt saunaøkt
- Tre aufguss-økter leia av saunamester
- Bad i fjorden
- Alkoholfri velkomstdrink
- Naturleg kroppsskrubb
- Ca. 30-45 minutt privat tid i saunaen
- Handkle er inkludert – eitt til å sitje på, eitt til å tørke seg med

No kan du bli FjordSauna-medlem!🔥 Meir sauna. Betre pris. Heile året.

For 500 kr får du medlemskap i 12 månader og tilgang til medlemsprisar på sauna i både Flåm og Aurland. Du betalar per saunaøkt du bestiller – til gjeldande medlemspris.

Medlemsprisane gjeld frå 15. september og varierer med sesong.

🎁 Alle nye medlemmar får ei lita velkomstgåve og dei første 50 får i tillegg eit KNUT-handlenett. Så her lønner det seg å vere kjapp på labben!

Les meir om medlemsprisar, korleis medlemskapet fungerer og bli medlem på FjordSauna.no. 

You can now become a FjordSauna member! 🔥 More sauna. Better prices. All year round.

For NOK 500, you get 12 months of membership and access to member prices on sauna sessions in both Flåm and Aurland. You pay per sauna session at member price.

Member prices apply from 15 September and vary depending on the season.

🎁 All new members receive a small gift and the first 50 members also get a KNUT tote bag. So be quick!

Read more about the member prices, how the membership works, and become a member at FjordSauna.com.

A huge thank you to Joe from The Maudsley CAMHS team for joining us and sharing his experience of bringing young people to the sauna over the past year.

He describes the sauna as a safe container for these young people to gently challenge themselves - meeting the cold, reconnecting with their bodies and discovering what they’re capable of, at their own pace. At the same time, it’s a calm and supportive space to interact with new people and build confidence in a way that feels manageable.

We’re really grateful to Joe for sharing his perspective and helping us understand the impact these sessions can have. 💙

After a five year wait hot showers and toilets are FINALLY here! 🚿

We know it hasn’t been easy. There were a lot of promises, a lot of waiting and a lot of you making the sauna-and-robe dash through the café in search of the toilet. Thank you for your patience and your good humour. 

We hope you feel more comfortable and looked after every time you visit, especially now the nights are drawing in and the weather gets colder! 💙

Lonely in London? Sauna as the new place to socialise... 🌀

London can be such a fun and busy city. But, despite being surrounded by so many people, us Londoners are feeling increasingly isolated.

Many of us are working from home. Typical social spaces revolve around alcohol and aren’t designed to help you meet new people. So, we’ve built a new kind of space...

When we opened last Autumn, we were chasing a dream we couldn’t quite find anywhere else.

A place to connect with people, listen to amazing music, and leave feeling really (really) good. All without the pressure to consume alcohol or any of nightlife’s other excesses.

Don’t get us wrong, London is home to SO many amazing independent nighttime venues, with incredible music programming. These venues still hold a special place in our hearts.

But the loneliness epidemic is real, and we wanted to create a space that truly brings people together. 

So whether you sauna for your physical health, mental health, or social connection - come alone or with friends. Everyone is welcome.

We can’t wait to meet you 🫧

When we opened our shutters in August 2024, it wasn’t just about building a business. It was about building the kind of Social Club we wished existed in London 🫧

So much of social life here is often centred around alcohol, with pubs and clubs the default for meeting friends or hearing new music. Our question was: what if you put sauna and ice bathing in its place? Instead of waking up with a hangover, you wake up feeling healthy and well-rested?

That spark of an idea became Sauna Social Club. A space for music, creativity and connection. A place where you might find yourself meditating to music in the listening sauna, sharing conversations in the chatty sauna, plunging into the ice baths, or simply curling up with a book.

With our backgrounds in the arts, social work, fitness and community organising, we set out to bring people together in a way that supports both health and creativity.

One year on, this feels less like our project and more like a community. Together we’ve created a new kind of social club — a place to connect, relax and be inspired. This film shares the story of how it all began.

Thank you to everyone who has joined us along the way. We could not have done it without you. Hope to see you in the sauna this winter!

With love,
Nikki & Benji x

we just got back from the International Sauna Congress in Oslo and we have a lot to say. 🔥🌊

it all opened in Oslo City Hall in the same room where the Nobel Peace Prize is handed out and left us with our favorite line of the trip: “there’s no war in a sauna.”

about 500 sauna people from around the world spent three days on culture, health, architecture and the future of the waterfront. 

Oslo, Copenhagen, Paris, Helsinki and Melbourne are all using saunas to bring people back to the water. 
once saunas show up on a waterfront, everything follows:

the robes, the community, the music, the food, the swimmers. city leaders who started out skeptical came around once they saw it.

huge thanks to @saunacongress2026 and a shoutout to @saunachannel for premiering Fire Between the Fjords.

the movement is global and we are happy to say that portland is part of it. we came home fired up about what we’re building here, on and off the water. 💧

latestPosts.caption: Romanticize your life with a swim in the rain before you warm back up next to a crackling wood fired sauna. These are the moments for us

Autumn in the PNW just hits different. 🍂🔥🌲

Crisp air, changing leaves, mist over the water… and stepping into the warmth of Wild Haus PNW while Seattle settles into fall.

There’s something about the contrast—the cold air outside, the heat of the sauna, and being surrounded by all those moody autumn colors—that makes you slow down and soak it all in.

This is what cozy season in the PNW is supposed to feel like. 

#WildHausPNW #PNWAutumn #CozySeason #FallVibes

Sweating our way through the last bit of Seattle summer with @wildhauspnw 🧖‍♀️🧖‍♀️ Apparently this is how we’re closing out Seattle Summer 2026 

Thank you @_alinvrr for planning and organizing everything. It was 10/10

This experience was meant to change the way you see the city. Unbeatable views of the skyline, dips in the lake, the occasional Rainier sighting and maybe some bald eagles overhead. A toasty warm wood fired sauna with an entire aromatherapy bar. Plush towels and robes to wrap up in. This is our version of Seattle, we hope you love it.

who said summers over? 

thanks @wildhauspnw for having us!!

Seattle’s coolest wellness activity 

@wildhauspnw in South Lake Union is a wood-fired sauna that cruises around Lake Union with your own captain. The boat has two levels, with the sauna downstairs and an open top deck for lounging. 

You can book a social sauna or rent out the entire boat for a private experience with friends. And of course, cooling off in the lake between sauna sessions is part of the fun. Or use the water bucket if you’d rather stay on board.

They also have water and hot tea available throughout the experience.

#seattlelife #southlakeunion #thingstodoseattle #seattlefun #seattlewellness

A floating sauna in the middle of Seattle?! 👀

We spent 90 minutes aboard Wild Haus warming up in the wood-fired sauna, adding aromatherapy to the steam, jumping straight into Lake Union and doing it all over again.

And plot twist: the water was 70 degrees, so even I couldn’t use “it’s too cold” as an excuse 😂 Between the water views, cozy rooftop lounge and swimming right off the deck, this was such a fun way to spend a sunny afternoon with friends.

Definitely one of the most unique Seattle experiences I’ve tried! Save this for your next Seattle day and tell me, would you jump in? 🌊

Hosted by @wildhauspnw 

#SeattleThingsToDo #SeattleExperiences #LakeUnion #VisitSeattle

Fall is in the air and the equinox is almost here. Join us for an extra special and autumnal Voyage hosted by @1hotel.seattle and @morgan_smile who will lead you through 90-minutes of hot cold therapy, meditation and breathwork. Spots WILL sell out so don’t miss the boat 😜. Link in bio to reserve your spot now.

A crew of us friends started the very thing we were craving and felt was missing in the city. An all season sauna boat where you can enjoy Seattle, rain or shine from the luxury of your own boat with a wood fired sauna, bucket shower and the ultimate roof deck. We saved you a seat, let us know what you think ⚓️
